q1_issues.issue: (Past (Member l_paul_bremer u_s)) makes the origin modifier "U.S." a class Bremer is an instance of, when it modifies the role (the administrator appointed by the U.S.), and it leaves a proper noun as a bare class symbol with no (Name ...) atom of its own.

"the northern cities of Erbil and Sulaimaniyah" is a definite plural with named members, which the instruction set encodes as a group witness ((GroupOf ... city) + (PartOf erbil ...) ) or by replicating the predication per conjunct; stacking a second Goal atom on one event is neither, and multiple same-role atoms on one event are licensed only for Agent on a collective/reciprocal predicate.
Same as statement 8 — the second conjunct is added as another Goal on the single visit event rather than as a group member or a replicated event.

q2_gaps: sentence-initial discourse adverb "Meanwhile" when the text supplies no second clause — there is no eventuality for a temporal relation to attach to and no licensed carrier for a discourse-level simultaneity adverb

support/light-verb construction over an event noun ("paid a two-hour visit to ...") — the light-verb rule names only occur / happen / take place, so treating the event noun's witness as the eventuality of "pay a visit" is an extension
notes: The appositive typing atoms correctly take the host clause's Past wrapper, the two-hour modifier is correctly a (Measure ... duration 2 hour), and (For l_paul_bremer iraq) is a licensed entity-attached surface-preposition oblique. "civilian administrator" is split into two atoms rather than fused as a role title (cf. senior_contractor); both readings are arguable, so I do not count it as a defect.
